pages.lines:
​
For 1-3 nights- $700 plus tax per night's stay (linen service not included)
​
For 4-6 nights- $680 plus tax per night's stay (linen service not included)
​
For 7 or more nights- $610 plus tax per night's stay (linen service not included)
A $400 non-refundable deposit is due at the time of reservation. Reservation is subject to room availability.
​
Individual building rental for Saloon and Schoolhouse (day use); $50.00 per building per day, due at reservation, non-refundable, and subject to availability. 10:00 am-4:00 pm. These can seat between 10 to 30 people. The buildings will be closed to other guests and set up per your needs. You are responsible for your own decorating. Tables/chairs above what is available on site will be your responsibility. Please have the buildings returned to pre-event condition at the end of the event schedule/day. These rooms are included in the exclusive use fee.
​
